description_en: Intelligently extracts structured information such as size charts and package weight/dimensions from images using a multimodal foundation model. (Asynchronous)
description_zh: 通过多模态大模型智能提取图片中的尺码图、件重尺等结构化信息。（异步）
name: SizeChartExtract

parameters.help_en: The URL of the size chart image to extract
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The list of column names (such as Size, Bust, Length)
parameters.help_zh: 列名列表（如 Size, Bust, Length 等）
parameters.name: column_name_list

parameters.help_en: The language model for output (such as en, cn). Set this parameter to cn for Chinese or en for English. If not specified, the original language is preserved
parameters.help_zh: 语言模型（如 en, cn 等）
parameters.name: language_model
